time_shift: one circular lag per dyad and repetition, integers 20..999 inclusive, shared across ROIs/bands
p_value: historical upper-tail (1 + count(null >= observed))/(101), without sign reorientation
time_gate: cohort mean trial-shuffle p <= .10 independently per geometry-target

tiers.overlap: separate tier per geometry; no combined tier

observed_statistic: mean across saved sampled centres of the pointwise production PhiID cell contrast
reference_copy: Public methods reference for the clinical launcher. The archived execution specification is retained separately.
